problem:
A particle $P$ moves in the $x$-$y$ plane (relative to a fixed origin $O$) with position vector

$$
r=⟨(t-4)^{3},\,(t-4)^{2}{e}^{-2{t}^{2}+3}⟩,\,t\in [0,\infty ).
$$

Calculate the time at which the particle is stationary. Do not round the answer.

The particle is stationary at $t=$
{{field-1}}.
